section.catchline: Record of assessment of public utility and air travel companies -- Review by county assessor.
section.subsection: Each year, the commission shall prepare a record of assessment of the following companies:public utility companies;airlines;air charter services; andair contract services.

The record of assessment under Subsection (1) shall include:the name of each person engaged in business within the state in a company described in Subsection (1);for each company described in Subsection (1), the total value of all of the company's tangible properties subject to assessment by the commission; andany other information as determined by the commission.

At the request of a county assessor, the commission shall provide to the county assessor:the record of assessment described in Subsection (1); andthe information upon which the assessments and apportionments contained in the record of assessment are made.
